load_json_gzip: create a function that loads a gzip-compressed JSON file and returns the parsed Python object
divide_list: build a utility that divides a list into N roughly equal sublists for parallel processing
HITLSession: create a HITLSession from a list of episode JSON files and a HITL data file to load episodes
HITLEpisode_sample_frames_at_frequency: run sample_frames_at_frequency on a HITLEpisode to discretize events into time-bucketed frames with a given delta_t
init_env: build a Habitat simulation environment from a HITLSession config with optional episode ID filtering
